en-us.kea_Q01:
"Who do you want me to look at?"
$kanon.name$ leans back in her chair, her gaze passing over the people $self.name$ brought along.
en-us.kea_L_evaluate: $kanon.name$ takes a ledger from the drawer and turns through it page by page, checking $actress.name$'s appearances against the sales figures.
en-us.kea_L_success:
"...Good enough."
$kanon.name$ closes the ledger.
"From today, $actress.name$ is billed as '$rankName$'. I'll adjust the pricing on her titles to match."
"Don't let her tarnish the name."
en-us.kea_L_fail:
"Not yet."
$kanon.name$ turns the ledger around and taps a few lines of figures.
$rankAdvice$
"Bring her back once those are covered."
en-us.kea_L_none: "If you want me to evaluate someone, bring her here first. I don't judge anyone I haven't seen in person."
en-us.kea_L_cancel: "Come by whenever. The ledger isn't going anywhere."
